comments.author: Holfina
comments.body: Are you visiting the Oxford professor sometimes? You only unlock new theses with him (or colony scholars if the colony has a college special building, I think). If you met the conditions for the Basic Prod Tech 3 thesis to be activated but didn't visit Oxford ever since, then the thesis will not be available to you at normal archive scholars. The skill is definitely there and possible to acquire, I have it.
